import { createPortal as mount } from 'react-dom';
import * as Dom from 'react-dom';
const portalAlias = mount;
declare const root: HTMLElement;
export const cases = <>
  <select><option>Choice</option></select>
  <dialog>Native dialog outside primitive</dialog>
  <div role="dialog" aria-modal="true">Modal</div>
  <div role="menu">Menu</div>
  <div role="listbox">Select</div>
  <div popover="auto">Native popover</div>
  <div className={`custom-dropdown ${true ? 'open' : ''}`}>Dropdown</div>
  <div className="new-modal-backdrop">Backdrop</div>
  {mount(<p>Portal</p>, root)}
  {Dom.createPortal(<p>Namespace portal</p>, root)}
  {portalAlias(<p>Alias portal</p>, root)}
</>;
document.createElement('dialog');
root.setAttribute('role', 'menu');
